nocite: '@*'

# NOTE: maintenance notes live HERE, in YAML comments -- pandoc passes <!-- -->
# straight through to the published page, so a body comment ends up in public
# page source.
#
# The empty ::: {#refs} ::: div below is load-bearing. Without it, citeproc
# appends the bibliography at the END of the document, which would drop the
# whole list below the Preprints and Software sections. The div pins it there.
#
# The peer-reviewed list deliberately has NO heading above it. "References" was
# wrong -- these are Adam's own publications, not works cited -- and any heading
# there stacks a second header directly under the page title. The intro line
# identifies the list instead. Preprints and Software are the only h2s.
#
# Preprint and Software entries are hand-written rather than bib records,
# because nocite: '@*' sweeps EVERY bib entry into the peer-reviewed list above
# -- a bib entry would appear in two sections at once. They are formatted to
# match int-res.csl output: Authors (Year) Title. Source.
#
# UPKEEP: when a preprint is published, DELETE it from the Preprints section
# below and add the journal version to references.bib. Leaving it in both places
# double-lists the same work.
#
# Software entries carry no version number on purpose: the Zenodo DOIs are
# concept DOIs that track the current release, so a pinned version would go
# stale on each release.
---
